_doc: The Briar Oath chapter 10, one against two. Hand-made (tools/maps/build_briar_maps.py). The Covenant comes out of the burned forest in the west; the lip of the Wound lies behind a ring of black rock in the east, where the Wyrdthorn must be planted, and two Ashen broods hold a town each north and south of it. The broods are allied computer players (team 1), at the easy difficulty (one against two). Laid out on a 34x26 grid and drawn 3.2x larger.
name: The Briar Seal
